title: Penelope | Sophisticated block heel sandal
bodyHtml:
Elevate your everyday style without any fuss. The Penelope heel features a sturdy block heel for all-day stability, an ankle strap for secure support, and an open design that keeps your feet cool and comfortable. A subtle contrast detail on the heel adds just enough modern edge to make it your go-to choice.

Why you'll love it

  • Block heel design provides stability and confidence with every step
  • Secure ankle strap keeps your foot in place, no matter where the day takes you
  • Open design keeps feet cool and comfortable in warm weather
  • Modern contrast detail lifts your look without trying too hard
  • Versatile enough for a casual lunch in Melbourne or a night out in Sydney
  • Pairs beautifully with everything from summer dresses to tailored trousers
  • The kind of shoe you reach for again and again – effortless style that actually lasts

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
